Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction. Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content.

Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device. Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity.

Adobe is going all in on agentic AI. Adobe is going all in on agentic AI Adobe is committing itself to the notion that chatbots and AI agents could be your next design assistant, or even automate creative workflows and repetitive tasks on your behalf.

Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation. Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns.
